description: Ecolab: gas datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ecolab. Coverage: Ecolab. The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about gas; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Part d'énergie fossile (charbon et produits pétroliers+ gaz naturel PC; Part des poids lourds électriques (et hydrogène) dans le parc roulant; Part des véhicules utilitaires légers électriques (et hydrogène) dans ; Part des et hydrogène dans les immatriculations de deux-roues. Formats seen: CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
